title: Do odd weird numbers exist (Erdős Problem #470)

problemStatement.plain: Formal mathematical investigation: Do odd weird numbers exist (Erdős Problem #470).

currentState.focus: Extended odd weird bound to >1575, proved weird_836

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Extended odd weird bound to >1575 (was >945). Proved 836 weird, 1575 semiperfect, no odd abundant in (945,1575). 7 new theorems added. 3 deep axioms remain.
